import numpy as np
A=np.array(grid)
# map positions where a 4x4 object fits in the union of 1s/2s and its own start area (all non-3)
free=(A!=3)
valid={(r,c) for r in range(17) for c in range(17) if np.all(free[r:r+4,c:c+4])}
start=(11,1)
from collections import deque
seen={start}; q=deque([start])
while q:
 r,c=q.popleft()
 for d in [(1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)]:
  p=(r+d[0],c+d[1])
  if p in valid and p not in seen:
   seen.add(p);q.append(p)
print('valid count',len(valid),'component',len(seen),'start valid',start in valid)
print('positions sorted',sorted(seen))
print('end states',[(p,[x for x in [(p[0]+1,p[1]),(p[0]-1,p[1]),(p[0],p[1]+1),(p[0],p[1]-1)] if x in valid]) for p in sorted(seen) if not any(x in valid for x in [(p[0]+1,p[1]),(p[0]-1,p[1]),(p[0],p[1]+1),(p[0],p[1]-1)])])
# Print feasible positions map: row top-left values, mark
for r in range(17):
 print(r, ''.join('O' if (r,c) in seen else '.' for c in range(17)))
